Title: Diagnosis of test `properlyMarksEntriesAsUnreadableIfUncompressedSizeIsUnknown`

The test `properlyMarksEntriesAsUnreadableIfUncompressedSizeIsUnknown` is checking whether `ZipArchiveInputStream` correctly marks entries as unreadable if the uncompressed size is unknown. 

1. The test creates a new `ZipArchiveInputStream` with an empty input stream.
2. It then creates a `ZipArchiveEntry` named "test" and sets its method to DEFLATED.
3. The test asserts that the `ZipArchiveInputStream` can read entry data for this entry.
4. Next, it sets the entry method to ENHANCED_DEFLATED and asserts that the `ZipArchiveInputStream` can still read entry data for this entry.
5. Then, it sets the entry method to BZIP2 and asserts that the `ZipArchiveInputStream` cannot read entry data for this entry.

The failure of this test indicates that the `ZipArchiveInputStream` is incorrectly marking the entry as readable even when the method is set to BZIP2, which should not allow reading entry data.

Next, I will investigate the implementation of the `canReadEntryData` method in the `ZipArchiveInputStream` class to understand why this behavior is occurring.
